items.currencyspending: Got too much of a currency? Pick the currency, amount, and server to find which item to buy with it for the most gil
items.xivtodo: Duty completion tracker for dungeons, raids, and trials (less useful for the dailies checklist)
items.msqtracker: Main Scenario Quest progress tracker, kept current through Dawntrail (progress saves to your browser only; export/import to move it, no shareable link)
items.ffxivprogress: MSQ progress tracker; stopped receiving updates after Endwalker, so use MSQTracker above for anything post-Endwalker
items.ffxivcollect: Look up and compare minions, mounts, and other collectibles you're tracking
items.eurekatracker: Eureka NM pop time tracker, the community standard
items.paissadb: Tracks open housing plots and wards in real time, what I use to find and review options before bidding
items.housingplotviewer: Browse screenshots and views for every plot so you can judge whether you'd like it without visiting in game
items.ffxivvenues: Directory and schedule of player-run venues across NA/EU data centers
items.eorzeacollection: Vanilla (no-mod) glamour gallery. Browse and save outfits for in-game use
items.fashionreportxiv: Weekly Gold Saucer Fashion Report hints, plus a solver that builds a high-scoring glam from items already in your inventory
items.discord: Main way I message friends and stay in touch with the community (heavy daily use)
items.twitch: In-game event streams and DJ sets
items.xivresources: Exhaustive, uncurated directory of FFXIV sites, APIs, and dev tools, for when this list doesn't have it
items.chocobocalc: Plan out chocobo color breeding/feeding paths
items.xivstats: General-purpose database with datasets you won't find elsewhere, like desynthesis results. The housing viewer for plot numbers is what I use most
items.icyveins: Job guides. I use it for a default crossbar/hotbar setup when leveling a new class on controller
items.xivbars: Visual drag-and-drop hotbar/crossbar builder that generates macros to import a layout on another device or share it, no screenshot needed
items.consolegameswiki: General item and quest info, easy to figure out what or how to go get something
items.retainerventures: List of every minion obtainable from retainer exploration ventures, and which venture unlocks each one
items.ffxivgardening: Hybrid seed crossbreeding paths. I use it for Thavnair onions
items.kuganetowerjump: Step-by-step screenshot guide to the Kugane rooftop jump puzzle near Bokairo Inn, up to the hidden hot spring sightseeing log on the roof
items.makaigear: How to earn Wolf Marks in PvP and what Makai gear costs at Wolves' Den Pier, plus the Garo titles and mounts
items.lodestone: Official news, maintenance, and lore updates
items.unicodereddit: Community-cataloged Unicode symbols that render in FFXIV chat and names
items.unicodegist: Broader Unicode reference table, linked to the FFXIV-relevant range
items.unicodelodestoneblog: Player-written Lodestone blog post listing special characters for names and chat
items.unicodewiki: Wiki page listing the special characters FFXIV's chat and name fields support
items.dalamud: Plugin framework for FFXIV client tools and mods. Install this first, everything else on this page runs through it
items.penumbra: Runtime mod loader, applies texture/model mods without touching game files. Custom repo, not in the default plugin directory
items.glamourer: Changes your character's outside appearance using Penumbra mods, what Glamaholic plates apply through. Custom repo, not in the default plugin directory
items.renireguide: Beginner-friendly walkthrough for setting up Penumbra and Glamourer to mod your character's appearance
items.bdth: Gizmo-based housing item positioning, far more precise than the in-game editor. Custom repo, not in the default plugin directory.
items.glamaholic: Save and swap glamour plates. Import looks straight from Eorzea Collection or someone else's export, try them on, and apply via Glamourer. In the default plugin repo but hidden from browsing, so search the exact name to install
items.xivmodarchive: Biggest free mod repository: glamour, gear, and animation mods, installed via Penumbra
items.heliosphere: Second mod source/manager I check when Mod Archive doesn't have what I'm looking for
items.glamourdresser: Paid mod marketplace. I don't usually pay, but a lot of creators unpaywall mods after a while, so I browse their Patreons for stuff that's gone free
items.compressyourself: Step-by-step guide to compressing mod textures for Lightless/PlayerSync. Keeps synced mod sizes down
items.chat2: Complete in-game chat window rewrite: unlimited tabs, better filtering, RGB channel colors, unread counts. A must-have
items.umbraxiv: Fully customizable toolbars and 3D world markers. In the default plugin repo but hidden from browsing, so search the exact name to install
items.betterfriendlist: Cross-server friend list with FC-style login/logout notifications. The other person needs it installed too for you to see theirs
items.dalamudpluginbrowser: Better search/browse UI for what's available in the main plugin repo than Dalamud's own in-game list
items.punish: Plugin studio/publisher I pull from a lot: Artisan, AutoRetainer, Pandora's Box, and more. Their repo goes under Dalamud's Experimental settings.
items.thebalance: Job theorycrafting hub, rotation guides, discord
items.gamerescapewiki: General item, quest, and game info. Alternate to the Console Games Wiki
items.heavenswhere: Interactive maps for hunts, gathering nodes, aether currents, and treasure (currently showing a maintenance page, recheck before relying on it)
items.jumppuzzlemacro: Timed macro technique for producing consistent, specific jump distances, with copyable macros and a calibration spot, useful for precision jumping puzzles
items.huntforastronomy: Every reward in the Hunt for Astronomy trove, its alternate sources, market board prices, and a straight verdict on what's worth the tomestones
items.tradeinmounts: Every FFXIV mount unlocked by trading in items or currency, with live market board prices and a straight verdict: grind it out, or buy your way there
items.inventorydecluttering: A keep, bank, or discard decision tree for a full bag or retainer, with storage tips, ways to sell or desynthesize, and the short list of items that never come back once discarded
items.retainerventurestool: Rank every retainer venture by what it earns on the market board for your retainer's class, level, and stats, with live prices and how fast the haul actually sells
items.keyboundbrawler: What every Keybound Brawler reward costs in MGC, how many runs it takes to afford them all, and how long the Magitype Magister title grind really is
items.fanfestbingo: Build your own Fan Fest keynote bingo card from predictions and running jokes, randomize it, play along live, and export a PNG to share
items.relictracker: Tracks relic weapon progress and what's still needed
items.sightseeinglog: Helper for the in-game Sightseeing Log bingo
items.oceanfishing: Upcoming ocean fishing voyage schedule, blue fish, and achievement info
items.ff14fish: Predicts weather/time windows for catching specific fish, the community standard for fishing spreadsheets
items.lifestream: Travel to another world, data center, or house with a single command. Custom repo, not in the default plugin directory
items.aetherphone: Adds a full smartphone interface in-game, social feed, messaging, photo sharing, market board, games. Recreates a lot of a home-screen experience. Custom repo, not in the default plugin directory
items.xivmac: Free, open-source macOS launcher that runs FFXIV through Wine, with one-click Dalamud setup built in, no separate Windows install needed for plugins
items.reshademac: One-command ReShade install for FFXIV under XIV on Mac, with shaders and textures pre-packaged, for players wanting graphics mods without a separate Windows install
items.patinafx: Apple silicon-only shader tool that loads ReShade community shaders into any Metal-rendered game, trying as an alternative after XIV on Mac's built-in ReShade setup turned out unstable
items.allagantools: Cross-storage inventory search and filtering across characters, retainers, and the Free Company chest, plus craft planning and marketboard integration right in tooltips. In the default plugin repo but hidden from browsing, so search the exact name (InventoryTools) to install
items.allaganmarket: Tracks retainer market listings, sales, and undercutting across every character at once. In the default plugin repo but hidden from browsing, so search the exact name to install
items.arealmreorganized: Scans the Glamour Dresser, Armoire, bags, Armory Chest, Saddlebag, and retainers for duplicates, partial sets, and items now eligible for the Armoire, then highlights them right in those windows. In the default plugin repo but hidden from browsing. Still in the author's test channel, haven't tried it myself yet
items.priceinsight: Shows NQ/HQ marketboard prices and the most recent sale directly on an item's tooltip on hover, pulled from Universalis. In the default plugin repo but hidden from browsing, so search the exact name to install
items.stacksellprice: Shows a full stack's vendor sell price on the tooltip instead of just one unit, so you don't have to do the multiplication yourself before deciding to vendor a pile of materials. In the default plugin repo but hidden from browsing, so search the exact name to install
items.repairme: Reminds you when gear needs repairing or still has materia to extract before you get rid of it. In the default plugin repo but hidden from browsing, so search the exact name to install
items.simpletweaks: Huge, individually toggleable grab-bag of quality-of-life tweaks; several touch inventory, retainers, and tooltips directly. In the default plugin repo but hidden from browsing, so search the exact name to install

hero.h1: Hunt for Astronomy: what's worth the tomes
hero.lede: Every item in the First Hunt for Astronomy trove, where else it drops, what it goes for on the market board, and a straight call on whether the event is the right way to get it. Tick what you want and it keeps a running tomestone total.

sky.aria: Every reward plotted by tomestone cost, coloured by verdict

grind.label: Worth the grind
grind.blurb: Event-only right now, or no sane alternative.

trove.label: Trove is the easy route
trove.blurb: Untradeable, and the permanent source is a slog.

gil.label: Cheap tomes, real gil
gil.blurb: Tradeable and sells for a lot relative to the tome cost.

buy.label: Buy or farm instead
buy.blurb: Tradeable or easy elsewhere. Don't burn tomes on these.

short.heading: The short version
short.sub: Most of this shop is stuff you can get elsewhere. The event matters for one mount, a couple of oddballs, and a few cheap items that sell for real gil.

fomo.heading: FOMO check
fomo.item1: {bold} The official page says it returns in the Second Hunt for Astronomy, and tokens from this hunt carry over. Teamcraft's data also shows a second-hunt listing that sells tokens for 30 Astronomy II tomes, so missing a minimog week isn't fatal (datamined, could change).
fomo.item2Bold: MGP card, both special maps and the job mastery prisms are trove regulars.
fomo.item2: {bold} They're also stocked in the “previous” and “past” irregular tomestone exchanges, so there's no rush.
fomo.item3: {bold} the uolon horn (until the Second Hunt) and the Mameshiba Neckerchief. Everything else, including the Ananta and Kotokaze cards, has a permanent Triple Triad or NPC source.
fomo.item4: {bold} Dhalmel whistles and emerald bardings are already listing well under their recent median. If you're buying to sell, sell early.

itemsSection.heading: Every reward
itemsSection.sub: Tap a row's "other ways to get it" for sources. Prices are live lowest listings and recent average sale price from Universalis, for the region or data center selected below.

hfa.empty: No rewards match these filters. Pick "All" to see the full shop.

footer.heading: Sources and how this was built
footer.src3: Alternate sources (shops, drops, FATEs, crafts, ventures): {link3} extracts, linked per item. Teamcraft's drop data can be incomplete, so an item with "no other source" is worth a second look on Garland Tools.
footer.src4: Market prices: lowest current listing and recent average sale price, pulled live from the {link4b} API for the region or data center selected above, cached locally with a manual refresh option. Also browsable on {link4a}.
footer.src5: Tomestone payouts per objective aren't listed on the event page; check the Mogpendium in game for the exact numbers.

50440.take: The headline reward and the only thing here that should shape your week. Do the ultimog challenge once (5 tokens) and a minimog each week (1 token). No need to panic: it's back in the Second Hunt and tokens carry over.
other: New mount, only sold in the irregular tomestone exchange. Returns in the Second Hunt for Astronomy.

24615.take: Teamcraft has no active source for it outside this shop, so if it's on your glam list, this is the window. If you've never thought about it, 50 tomes is a lot for a neck slot.
other: No current source outside the trove per Teamcraft (marked deprecated).

30107.take: The alternative is a drop-rate lottery in an old savage fight. If you want the mount and don't feel like farming chests, 50 tomes is a fair trade.
other: Duty drop, Eden's Verse: Refulgence (Savage)
